concept.concept: T-shirt reading 'Principal, Teacher, Lunch Lady, IT Department' stacked in a vertical school-schedule format.
concept.rationale: Back-to-school timing is highly relevant for this audience. Homeschool community is passionate, tightly networked, and actively seeks identity merchandise. The multi-role humor concept is relatable and original. Competition exists but less saturated than mainstream teacher merch. Good evergreen tail beyond the season.

design.image_prompt: Flat vector illustration of a vertical school schedule board with four rectangular blocks stacked, each containing one role. Design in bold simple shapes with clean sharp edges, screen-print aesthetic. Color palette: deep navy blue, bright white, warm golden yellow, charcoal gray. Solid color blocks only, no gradients, no shading, no photorealism. Single centered composition on plain cream background with generous margins. Readable at 12x16 inches from across a room.
design.text_on_design:
Principal
Teacher
Lunch Lady
IT Department
design.style: Bold sans-serif, stacked vertically in separate rectangular blocks, each text in alternating colors (white on navy, white on golden, white on charcoal, white on navy), mimicking a school schedule board layout

verdict.reason: The design consists entirely of generic occupational titles commonly associated with school staff roles. None of the terms are trademarked phrases, branded slogans, or references to specific characters, celebrities, or intellectual property. The humor derives from the relatable concept of one person wearing many hats in a school setting, which is a generic and widely used comedic trope. No IP concerns identified.

image_verdict.reason: Clean graphic design featuring four stacked rounded rectangles in different colors (blue, yellow, cream, dark gray) each displaying the word 'ROLE' in bold text. Text is clear and correctly spelled, no IP concerns, no recognizable characters or logos, no anatomy issues. Simple and suitable for garment printing.

listing.title: Principal Teacher Lunch Lady IT Department Homeschool Parent Shirt
listing.description: For the homeschooling parent who wears every hat at once. This tee celebrates the reality of managing curriculum, classrooms, meal prep, and tech support all in one household. Stacked text in school-schedule format makes a humorous statement about the many roles parents play. Perfect gift for homeschool families, homeschool co-op members, and anyone juggling education at home. Comfort-fit 100% cotton, available in unisex sizing. Ideal for back-to-school season, parent appreciation, or just acknowledging the beautiful chaos of homeschooling.
